newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines starts new US-Mexico routes.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines starts new US-Mexico routes.

text.p: American Airlines said Tuesday it will soon begin two new nonstop routes between the United States and Mexico, as well as add service on two existing routes.
The carrier said it will restore nonstop service between San Antonio, Texas, and Mexico City beginning November 1. It said it offered the service many years ago.
American also said it would start daily nonstop service betwen Miami and Monterrey beginning December 15.
The carrier said it also will begin additional nonstop service between its Dallas/Fort Worth hub and Guadalajara and Los Cabos.
